entries.rationale: Command substitution $(...) forks a new process, which is expensive in loops. SS QLM mandates using Bash's internal parameter expansion for O(1) performance and process-less execution.
External calls to 'sed' for simple global replacement are unnecessary. Internal syntax '${var//search/replace}' is faster and safer as it avoids shell-escaping issues inherent in pipe streams.
SS QLM standardizes trimming without external binaries, ensuring scripts remain responsive even when handling thousands of variables per second.
